jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, CreativeFlux, AI Studios
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios as a Machine Learning Engineer on CreativeFlux, the ML platform powering Nara, our AI-native content creation platform for professional animation and live action/VFX.  
  
You will own the training and serving infrastructure that puts generative models in front of artists working on Prime Video's animated and live action productions. You'll work daily with Applied Scientists, animators, filmmakers, and storytellers, building the systems that turn new model architectures into production-grade tools artists can rely on under tight deadlines.  
  
This role suits engineers who want their work to expand what storytelling can look like, putting new generative capabilities into the hands of the people building Prime Video's animated and live action shows.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, deploy, and operate ML training and inference workloads on EKS, including GPU node groups, custom schedulers, autoscaling, resource quotas, and gang scheduling for multi-GPU jobs  
Integrate generative ML models (image, video, audio) into production inference pipelines, partnering with Applied Scientists to take new architectures from research to scaled deployment  
  
Build training and fine-tuning pipelines on EKS and SageMaker, including data preparation, distributed training, evaluation harnesses, and checkpointing strategies  
  
Improve GPU utilization, throughput, and latency on the inference fleet through batching, quantization, model compilation, serving framework tuning, and Kubernetes-native scaling primitives (HPA, KEDA, custom controllers)  
  
Build automated evaluation pipelines and quality metrics that catch model regressions before they reach Artists, including human-in-the-loop review where needed  
  
Drive integrations with Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro at the points where models are surfaced to creators  
  
Own operational health of model endpoints on EKS, including monitoring, alerting, on-call response, capacity planning, and post-incident analysis  
Write clean, well-tested code and participate in design and code reviews  
  
Stay current with generative ML, distributed training, inference optimization, and GPU efficiency techniques, and apply them to move team metrics  
  
A day in the life  
As an MLE on the AI Studios team, you'll deploy and tune generative ML models, optimizing inference pipelines, and build EKS infrastructure that empowers Scientists productionalize new model architectures. A typical day includes scaling video generation endpoints, debugging multi-GPU training pipelines, or supporting a Scientist to migrate a new image model from a research notebook to a serving fleet. You'll work with other Nara platform teams to ensure ML capabilities land cleanly in production artists workflows. You'll join team standups, model review sessions, on-call rotations, and platform-wide design reviews. You'll learn from experienced engineers and scientists to gradually take on more complex challenges over time.  
  
About the team  
We're AI Studios within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, building Nara, our AI-native content creation platform. Our mission is to make Amazon a leader in AI-enabled content creation, giving creators direct control over model outputs while reducing the cost and timeline of animation and live action productions.  
  
Our engineering team spans distributed systems engineers building scalable infrastructure, ML engineers optimizing 1P model training and inference, and full-stack engineers building creative facing agentic tools.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 3+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**JOIN THE COME AND SEE TEAM**

**QA Automation Engineer**

**Every person who presses play deserves a product that works, and quality is how we honor them.** If you love building systems that catch problems early and see quality as a way to serve people well – we’d love to meet you.

**ABOUT US**

Come and See is the faith-based nonprofit media ministry behind **The Chosen**. Our mission is **inviting everyone to encounter Jesus through exceptional storytelling that brings the Bible to life.** Our Team Members work together as collaborators in the greatest mission on earth.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The QA Automation Engineer will build our automated testing strategy and coverage across web, mobile, connected TV, API, and backend platforms, integrate testing into our CI/CD pipelines, and support manual and exploratory testing where automation isn’t yet practical. This is a full-time, remote role open to candidates in the USA.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Shape the testing strategy.** Help define automation standards, choose the right testing layers for each product, and prioritize by risk, business impact, and effort.
* **Champion testability.** Advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle and mentor teammates on where automation adds value and where manual validation still belongs.
* **Build automated test suites.** Design, write, and maintain tests for critical user journeys, APIs, and integrations, with reusable frameworks, fixtures, and patterns for test data and mocking.
* **Keep tests reliable.** Diagnose and fix flaky tests, and keep suites maintainable as products and architecture evolve.
* **Choose the right tools.** Evaluate, prototype, and recommend testing frameworks and services, including AI approaches to test creation and maintenance, before wider adoption.
* **Wire testing into CI/CD.** Work with Engineering on which tests run for pull requests, builds, deployments, and scheduled regression, and help set quality gates that don’t slow delivery.
* **Make quality visible.** Improve visibility into test results, failures, and trends, and trace failures to application code, test code, infrastructure, or environments.
* **Test what automation can’t.** Perform manual, exploratory, and regression testing across supported platforms and devices, and document and help diagnose defects.
* **Improve with the team.** Work with Product Managers, Engineers, and Product Operations to validate acceptance criteria, learn from recurring defects, and keep improving our practices.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* 5+ years in software quality assurance, test automation, or software engineering, using modern automated testing frameworks
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests
* Experience testing web applications, APIs, mobile applications, or other digital platforms
* Strong grasp of testing principles, including regression, integration, end-to-end, exploratory, and risk-based testing
* Ability to write code or scripts for test automation, with working knowledge of CI/CD and Git workflows
* Experience diagnosing failures across applications, tests, environments, and integrations
* A personal faith in Jesus and alignment with our mission, values, and Statement of Faith

  

**BONUS POINTS:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, experience establishing or expanding an automated testing program, testing across web, iOS, Android, and connected TV, CI/CD integration, API and integration testing, cloud testing infrastructure or device farms, performance or accessibility testing, experience leveraging AI-assisted development or testing tools to improve engineering productivity and test automation, streaming, media, or high-scale consumer product experience, nonprofit or ministry/faith-based organizational experience

**BENEFITS:** Medical, dental, vision, retirement match, HRA, disability and life insurance, generous and flexible time off, holidays, parental leave, and more.

**OUR BELIEFS, CULTURE, AND COMMITMENT**

At Come and See, every staff member is a critical and valuable part of our mission and ministry. We consider ministry readiness and an individual’s capacity to represent our culture and Christian beliefs during the selection process for all staff positions. An essential function within every position held by a staff member at Come and See is to uphold and represent Jesus in how we live and behave.

While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn’t mean uniformity. Our calling is too great, and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team with people from all backgrounds. We believe that varied perspectives—across race, ethnicity, life experience, age, and gender—enrich our ability to share the story of Jesus with the world and help everyone, everywhere, experience the authentic Jesus.

Come and See is an equal opportunity employer and as a religious organization, lawfully exercises its right under Title VII and applicable state law to employ individuals who share its religious beliefs.

For accommodations, contact peopleandculture@comeandseefoundation.org

**Application Deadline:** November 27, 2026

##### **Your Impact**

Own your opportunity to be on the frontlines of health innovation. Deliver for America’s health agency missions and enhance lives for hundreds of millions every day.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a **Gatling Test Automation Engineer – API & UI Integration** supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Federally Facilitated Exchange (FFE). GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career.
  
  
At GDIT, people are our differentiator. GDIT, supports CMS's FFE program with new functionality development for Plan Management, Eligibility & Enrollment (E&E), Financial Management, Marketplace Consumer Record, and other Marketplace Health Exchange functional areas. As a Gatling Test Automation Engineer – API & UI Integration, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this position.

  
  

Our work depends on a Gatling Test Automation Engineer – API & UI Integration joining our team to perform continuous testing for security, APIs, UI integrations, and running regressions manually as required. You will participate in scrum meetings, perform test case execution, and report and document defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process. In this role, a typical day will include:

* Plan test scenarios and develop, execute, maintain, and document test cases.
* Develop and maintain automated test suites and frameworks using Scala, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
* Define and add automated regression scripts and Gatling simulations; update the framework as needed to support functional design enhancements.
* Build and enhance Scala/Selenium frameworks for UI and API integration.
* Assess manual functional test cases for automation opportunities and test coverage.
* Prepare and manage test data, validate data integrity, and expand the regression test bed across releases.
* Work with functional testers, developers, and subject-matter experts to troubleshoot regression failures.
* Execute and monitor automated tests through Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines, including build and deployment validation.
* Perform code-quality reviews and technical architecture upgrades to support system efficiency.
* Estimate testing effort for new functionality and enhancements, and report test cases added during each sprint and release.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:**

* Bachelor's degree (candidate résumé should include names from institutes of hirer learning) plus 8+ years of experience designing and developing tests and test requirements for products, systems, software, and/or related components.
* Hands-on test-automation development experience using **Gatling**, including developing or updating simulations and automated regression tests **from scratch**.
* Experience developing and maintaining test-automation frameworks using **Scala, JavaScript**, **Java**, and/or **Python** for **REST APIs.**
* Experience with **Selenium** for UI and API integration testing.
* Experience using test and development tools such as **Bruno**, **Postman**, **IntelliJ IDEA**, **Visual Studio Code**, and/or **Eclipse**.
* Experience with test-data preparation, management, validation, and database query or management tools.
* Knowledge of **Unix/Linux commands** and **shell scripting** to execute and monitor test scripts, batch processes, and automation jobs.
* Experience integrating **AI tools** (preferably **Claude**-based frameworks) into testing or development workflows.
* Experience with **Jenkins** for CI/CD pipeline execution, automated test scheduling, deployment validation, and build monitoring.
* Must consistently deliver work that meets or exceeds established standards, demonstrating accuracy, attention to detail, thoroughness, and adherence to specifications.
* Candidate must have established residency in the U.S. for at least 3 out of the last 5 years.
* Candidate must be able to obtain a Federal Public Trust.
  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with data conversion and data-driven mapping using XQuery, SQL, or another database language.
* Previous software-development experience.
* Basic Python or JavaScript experience supporting automated test suites.
* Strong problem-solving, organization, attention to detail, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Agile certification in SAFe Practitioner, SAFe Agilist, CSM or other agile certifications.
* Ability to perform in high pressure environment and under strict deadlines.
  

  

**GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:**

* 401K with company match
* Comprehensive health and wellness packages
* Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
* Cutting-edge technology you can learn from

Years of Experience

8 + years of related experience

Certification

None
